label: v241
changes: You can now turn religious suggestions back on from inside the name-day screen itself. It used to tell you the setting was off and then leave you to go and find it — abandoning whatever you were editing to get there.
Turning it on runs the search again straight away, so you get the answer you came for instead of having to ask a second time.
It's an admin-only setting and it applies to the whole family, so the screen says both out loud. If you're not an admin it tells you who can change it rather than showing a button that wouldn't work.
